outputs.summary:
Fixed the actual refresh gap: board mutations refreshed only the board, leaving the sidebar count stale until polling. KanbanBoard now delegates changes to the shell folder-refresh callback when mounted by App (retaining standalone reload fallback). Existing correct open-lane arithmetic, Done totals/pagination, epic counts and approval rules are unchanged. Added observable immediate approval/deletion and completion/all-Done regressions; updated README.
Final integration: reviewed and merged through https://github.com/davgor/DarkMechanicus/pull/37 into main (81a5287c9899d1f5ef63732b39fe77ff955cf0dc).
